data.name: Caralie
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Caralie is derived from the name 'Karalos' which means 'dear, precious'. The name evolved in Latin to 'Cara' meaning 'dear' and 'Alia' meaning 'other'. Combined, Caralie means 'pure, clear, dear one'. In Christian traditions, Caralie represents the pure and innocent spirit of a child.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine love and purity
